title: Google Keep: historical voice capture
role_for_mira: Familiar Android capture-and-result sequence; Talk capture clarity and Activities/Journal return-to-work continuity.

provenance.kind: keyframes from official animated GIF; GIF cadence is not device performance

target_reference.units: logical design units, not measured donor dp

spatial_ergonomic.measurement_basis: Qualitative visual reading of retained frames. Regions below are relative roles; source screenshots/GIFs do not expose device density or reliable native dp. Marketing/device chrome is not counted as app content.

regions.description: Existing note cards establish the destination for the captured result.
A centered capture dialog contains a mic and status; surrounding collection is dimmed.
A note result appears, then the collection includes the new text result.

spatial_ergonomic.reference_zone_status: Proposed comparison grid only; donor controls may fall outside these bands. Not a fixed-coordinate implementation rule.

visual_density.value: Collection: medium; capture dialog: low; resulting note: low/medium.

transitions.trigger: Finish speaking in the historical demonstration

states_and_triggers.limitation: Visible states are observations; documented arrows use source flow/guide descriptions. No event-handler names, gesture thresholds, or unseen screens are inferred as measured behavior.

observation.value: The GIF shows collection, capture dialog, result, and return. Sampled asset timestamps are available; the recording does not establish real capture latency or current Keep behavior.

visual_or_documented_feedback.value: The captured asset is an animated GIF with no audio track. The article documents voice capture and a text/audio result; specific tones and haptics remain unknown.

hierarchy.value: The active capture dialog uses a short instruction, then exposes the result. The current task is visually separated from the existing collection.

copy_and_cognitive_load.note: No OCR word-count or grade-level measurement is claimed. Use the Mira copy sheet for exact comparison text.

mira_synthesis_candidate.value: Borrow explicit capture/result feedback and continuity back to kept work. Talk remains hold-to-speak, not the donor automatic-end mechanism. Journal voice notes remain saved audio attachments; do not imply automatic transcription.
